scope: Headless GUT shutdown after all project tests. Raw counts include Godot-held global script classes; they may only be recalibrated after an audited pinned GF vendor-tree or project runtime class-set change, and must not grow while both inputs remain unchanged.
calibration_reason: The exact official GF 11.0.0-dev.0 development snapshot advances from 6750f8dc to c3ce437c after the canonical full validation and merge gate succeeded. The audited vendor global-script class set increases from 842 to 848. The audited project runtime class set increases from 242 to 281 for the module-boundary split, shared platform ports, generic chunked-profile persistence substrate, and the bounded Bookmark and Replay chunk decoders, prepared-state ownership objects, and shared variant-budget helpers. Godot is pinned to 4.7.2 after the manual engine upgrade. A complete 952-test run reported ObjectDB=34, Resources=5, and RID types=0, so the reviewed ObjectDB, Resource, RID, and PagedAllocator ceilings are intentionally retained without increase.
